document.title: Leave outdated comments unpinned
document.summary: A review comment is pinned only when it still sits on one line at head and its thread is open.
document.why: [#128](source:s1) says outdated and resolved comments show on the review, sometimes in the wrong location.

commits.subject: Leave resolved and outdated review comments unpinned
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
A line pin is the forge's current line on an open thread. A resolved
thread and an outdated comment stay a source with no pin, so original_line
cannot land on a different line at head.
